source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseMessagingDeterministic001Test { private class Handler implements Messaging.InboundEmailHandler { public Messaging.InboundEmailResult handleInboundEmail(Messaging.InboundEmail email, Messaging.InboundEnvelope envelope) { Messaging.InboundEmailResult result = new Messaging.InboundEmailResult(); result.success = true; result.message = envelope.toAddress; return result; } } private class NotificationHandler implements Messaging.NotificationActionHandler { public Messaging.ActionResult executeAction(Messaging.ActionableNotification notification) { return new Messaging.ActionResult.Builder().build(); } } @isTest static void dtoShapes() { Messaging.ActionResult action = new Messaging.ActionResult.Builder().build(); System.assertNotEquals(null, action); Messaging.ActionableNotification notification = new Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder().build(); System.assertNotEquals(null, notification); Messaging.AuthenticationResultField authField = new Messaging.AuthenticationResultField(); authField.name = 'smtp.mailfrom'; authField.value = 'example.test'; System.assertNotEquals(null, authField.clone()); Messaging.AuthenticationResult auth = new Messaging.AuthenticationResult(); auth.authenticationResultFields = new List<Messaging.AuthenticationResultField>{authField}; auth.method = 'spf'; auth.result = 'pass'; System.assertNotEquals(null, auth.clone()); System.assertEquals('spf', auth.method); System.assertEquals('pass', auth.result); Messaging.BinaryAttachment binary = new Messaging.BinaryAttachment(); binary.body = Blob.valueOf('attachment'); binary.fileName = 'attachment.bin'; binary.headers = new List<Messaging.Header>(); binary.mimeTypeSubType = 'application/octet-stream'; System.assertNotEquals(null, binary.clone()); System.assertEquals('attachment.bin', binary.fileName); Messaging.Builder builder = new Messaging.Builder(); System.assertNotEquals(null, builder.clone()); Messaging.EmailFileAttachment file = new Messaging.EmailFileAttachment(); System.assertEquals(null, file.id); Messaging.Header header = new Messaging.Header(); header.name = 'Content-Type'; header.value = 'text/plain'; System.assertNotEquals(null, header.clone()); System.assertEquals('Content-Type', header.name); System.assertEquals('text/plain', header.value); Messaging.MassEmailMessage mass = new Messaging.MassEmailMessage(); System.assertNotEquals(null, mass); NotificationHandler notificationHandler = new NotificationHandler(); System.assertNotEquals(null, notificationHandler); Handler handler = new Handler(); Messaging.InboundEmailResult handled = handler.handleInboundEmail(new Messaging.InboundEmail(), new Messaging.InboundEnvelope()); System.assertEquals(true, handled.success); System.assertEquals(null, handled.message); } }
